A Bitcoin Seed Generator Is Using Radioactive Decay for Entropy

An open-source project called Entropy32 Plus uses radioactive decay as a physical entropy source to generate Bitcoin BIP39 seed phrases. A Geiger counter captures decay events, whose timing is processed through SHA-256 before being mapped to the BIP39 wordlist. The device is designed to operate fully offline with no wireless connectivity or persistent seed storage. Huobi Founder Leon Li Sells London Mansion for £190M After Buying It for £139M

According to the Financial Times, Huobi founder Leon Li recently sold The Holme, a mansion in London's Regent's Park, for approximately £190 million. Li purchased the property for £139 million in 2024, resulting in a price difference of roughly £51 million in less than two years. Li's ownership had not previously been made public because the property was held through a UK subsidiary of trust services provider Zedra. The buyer was Abbas Sajwani, son of Dubai property developer Hussain Sajwani. — link
